content.title: Life and Ministry Meeting Workbook, November 16-22

content.text: {"off_topic":false,"field_ministry":{"title":"Start Conversations With Kindness","summary":"The demonstrations show how a warm question can open a conversation about the comfort the Bible offers.","apply":[{"text":"Ask one neighbor how they are coping, and listen before sharing a verse.","ref":"Psalm 34:18"}]},"living":{"title":"Comfort Those Who Mourn","summary":"The part encourages us to notice who is grieving in the congregation and to offer practical help.","apply":[{"text":"Send a short card or message to someone who is having a hard time.","ref":"2 Corinthians 1:3, 4"}]},"congregation_bible_study":{"title":"Jehovah Is Near Those Who Hurt","summary":"The chapter explains how Jehovah supports those who feel crushed and how we can lean on him.","notes":[{"paragraphs":"1–3","text":"Everyone faces loss, and Jehovah understands what it does to us.","ref":""},{"paragraphs":"4–7","text":"He draws close to those who feel crushed, and gives strength to keep going.","ref":"Psalm 34:18"},{"paragraphs":"8–10","text":"Prayer, the Bible and our brothers and sisters are ways he comforts us.","ref":""}],"jehovah":[{"text":"He notices pain that others may miss.","ref":""}],"comments":[{"paragraph":"5","text":"When I was low, a verse a friend shared helped me feel Jehovah close.","ref":""}]}}
